notes.observation: Unit 2 ends `தன்னுடைய கட்டிலில்` and unit 3 continues `போய்ப் படுத்துக் கொண்டு`.
Pavazhakkara Street meeting is framed as fire/earthquake/cyclone/volcano emotion overcome by Anna's tender speech, tears and compassion.
notes.translation_action: Preserve the contrast and the title's claim that tenderness/compassion won.

notes.observation: Anna tells Kalaignar he has been made a member of the propaganda committee.
First DMK meeting concludes in rain at Robinson Park, followed by Anna's late-night strategy discussion.
notes.translation_action: Preserve sequence from public founding meeting to intimate organizational work.

notes.observation: Devarasa Mudaliar's hall has torn sofa, broken chairs, holey mats, dirty pillows; kara boondi, pakoda and single tea form the hourly feast.
notes.translation_action: Keep material modesty and affectionate irony of `Anna's royalty`.

notes.observation: Kannadasan sleeps through repeated knocking; a small black cobra is found beneath a breakfast plate on Kalaignar's bed; guards kill it and warn there may be more young snakes.
notes.translation_action: Preserve comic suspense and concrete sequence without exaggerating zoological certainty.

notes.observation: Kalaignar asks Kannadasan to swap beds; Kannadasan calls him a coward and snores, leaving Kalaignar to sleep sitting in a chair with the light on.
notes.translation_action: Preserve dialogue, teasing friendship and punchline.
